postings.title: IT Workplace Engineer (all genders)
postings.description:
IT Workplace Engineer (all genders)

🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​

About Beyond Gravity

Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com

Our Crew

The IT Workplace Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting the end‑user computing environment to ensure a secure, efficient, and modern digital workplace experience. This role bridges engineering and operations, focusing on device management, collaboration tools, identity, and automation, while continuously improving user experience and service quality.

Your Mission

Digital Workplace & End‑User Computing

- Design, deploy, and manage modern workplace solutions (Windows, macOS, mobile devices).

- Ensure consistent, secure, and high‑quality end‑user experience across devices and platforms.

- Act as an escalation point (3rd line) for complex workplace-related incidents and problems.

Device & Endpoint Management

- Administer and optimize endpoint management platforms (e.g. Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Jamf, SCCM).

- Manage OS deployment, configuration baselines, patching, and lifecycle management.

- Implement compliance, security, and conditional access policies for endpoints.

- Manage central Software packaging, configuration and distribution based on SCCM and MS Intune.

Collaboration & Productivity Tools

- Support and enhance collaboration platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365: Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint).

- Management of Teams PSTN connections

- Work closely with stakeholders to improve adoption and effective use of workplace tools.

- Ensure availability, performance, and governance of collaboration services.

- Printer Management - 2nd and 3rd level support for different Printing solutions

- 2nd level support for Logitech and MS Teams Room environment for all BG markets

- Incident handling of Level 3 issues with main suppliers (MS, Logitech, ScreenBeam) and all future technologies

Identity, Security & Access

- Collaborate on identity and access management (Azure AD / Entra ID).

- Support MFA, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust initiatives.

- Work with Security teams to align workplace solutions with security standards and policies.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

- Automate workplace operations using PowerShell, scripts, or low-code tools.

- Improve reliability, scalability, and efficiency through standardization and automation.

- Contribute to service improvement initiatives and roadmap planning.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

- Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and architectural diagrams.

- Support knowledge transfer to Service Desk and operations teams.

- Promote best practices and standards across the workplace environment.

Your Story

Must’s:

- Technical degree, preferably at university level

- Appropriate technical experience, great technical interest and generally very good skills in IT

- Microsoft certifications (e.g. MD‑102, MS‑102, AZ‑104).

- Experience with VDI/DaaS solutions (Azure Virtual Desktop, Citrix).

- Familiarity with security frameworks (Zero Trust, CIS, ISO 27001).

- Experience supporting hybrid or remote-first workforces.

- Exposure to ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.

- Fluent English

Nice to have’s:

- Good project management skills

- Experience and knowledge of Unix/Linux OS´s

Why Beyond Gravity?

You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
You will work in a growing high-tech company with career opportunities within the location or internationally.
In Lisbon we have a down-to-earth culture, experienced and competent employees and a versatile management team. We offer a hybrid work situation (two times per week in the office) and flexible hours to match your rhythm. We have moved to our brand-new office in Entrecampos.We have a canteen (with free breakfast and snacks), free parking spots in our garage and great access to our office either by car or public transports (just next to the train station in Entrecampos).
We offer a competitive salary, meal allowance, health insurance and much more.

🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​ Please submit your CV in English.

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: ​Catarina Rio | | catarina.afonsorio@beyondgravity.com

​

Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​

​

Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.

postings.title: Lead Analysis Engineer
postings.description:
Lead Analysis Engineer

🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​

About Beyond Gravity

Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com

Responsible for the analysis discipline within a business unit, from a technical perspective. Sets technical direction, develops analysis capabilities, and ensures alignment with business goals and analysis standards. Coaches analysis engineers, represents the company in technical forums, and influences product strategy through deep analysis insights.

Our Mission

- Owns analysis methodologies across programs. Guides team in advanced topics and ensures compliance with standards. Defines internal methodologies and standards and ensures alignment with industry best practices.

- Drives cross-disciplinary analysis strategies across programs. Establishes best practices for collaboration and data exchange between analysis domains. Promotes versatility and continuous learning within the team.

- Defines CAE workflows and ensures consistency across projects. Reviews and approves FE models and results for critical components. Reviews and approves modeling approaches across projects. Ensures consistency, traceability and best practices in modeling assumptions.

- Defines strategy for tool development and digitalization. Oversees tools lifecycle, training, and cross-functional integration.

- Owns test-analysis integration across programs and establishes best practices for prediction and correlation. Represents the analysis discipline in test planning and reviews and drives innovation in test support methodologies.

- Leads Root Cause investigation from technical stand point and secure measures for corrective and preventive actions. Actively propose technical solutions in his field of activity. Implement Lessons Learn and find synergies accross the product line/portfolio. Signs all dispositions and has the associated responsibilities.

- Develops strategies for data governance and digital continuity within project. Effectively summarizes and communicates across multiple projects or an entire product line. Prepares strategic-level reporting tailored to senior stakeholders. Trusted to shape high-impact presentations for decision-makers.

- Is proficient in at least 2 engineering discipline and understand other discipline challenges.
Compute roadmap and case study. Bring new technology in the business

- Is the owner of all bidding and proposal for the discipline. Leads cross-functional proposals.

- Leads discussions and decision making process. Mentor other in reasoning and push his peer to critical thinking. Is the reference in terms of engineering judgement. Solves high stakes ambiguous problems.

- Weighs technical challenges together with other business relevant input (e.g. cost, timeframe…)

- Oversees the discipline compentences and ensures staff is properly trained. Identify, manage and maintain Key Competences within the department. Identify the core competences of tomorrow. Drives organisational learning and talent development strategies. Note: responsibilities share with line manager when applicable

- Leads complex, cross-functional task initiatives. Aligns task execution with organizational strategies. Mentors teams in prioritization, automation, and focus strategies.

- Set the course of product development together with the respective product lead

Your Story

- BS or MS in Aerospace, Mechanical or other engineering, or equivalent experience.

- 15+ years of analysis experience, including 10+ in aerospace industry.

- Expert-level proficiency in FEA tools.

- Demonstrated technical authority in FEA.

- Advanced knowledge in detailed stress analysis, test prediction and correlation and test plans definition.

- Demonstrated ability to define, review, and approve stress analysis methodologies.

- Experience in technical governance and competence development.

- Understands and complies with internal processes.

- Strong leadership and communication skills.

- Build-up and maintain relevant contact with external stakeholders.

- In-depth knowledge of aerospace structures and components design and materials, preferred

- Solid experience in composites, sandwich structures and lightweight materials, preferred.

- Solid experience in shock, thermal and acoustic analysis, preferred.

- Solid demonstrated experience in F&DT analysis, preferred.

- Knowledge of the space industry and market, preferred

- Strong project management capabilities, preferred.

🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. Propel your career to new heights by applying. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​

For questions regarding the position, please contact: ​​Joseph Damis | joseph.damis@beyondgravity.com
​

For questions regarding the position or recruitment process, please contact: ​​Michelle Lach | michelle.lach@beyondgravity.com

​

Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​

Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com

The Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for daily structures production support. The successful individual in this role is a creative, solutions-oriented engineer that takes ownership of manufacturing processes to drive world class Safety, Quality, Cost and Delivery performance into the business.

Your Mission

- Provide daily support to manufacturing operations and related support teams in order to assure technically correct manufacturing and product flow, thereby assuring the necessary quality, OTD, and production costs

- Work cross-functionally with operations, quality, design engineering, and other teams to define manufacturing work instructions, equipment, tools, materials, and training

- Utilize project management techniques / tools to meet cost, technical, and schedule requirements

- Play key role in the non-conformance process and secure measures for root cause analyses, corrective and preventive measures

- Support continuous improvements in concerned manufacturing processes to deliver in line with customer quality, cost, and demand requirements

- Establish and provide the necessary documentation in support of strategic operations programs as well as for customer programs, support and participate in project reviews as necessary

- Proactively support and coach the production technicians through frontline support utilizing an integrated project team approach; provide training material (both software and hardware) as needed

- Establish standard work practices across manufacturing and eliminate waste to increase productivity

- Develop and verify new jigs, tooling, equipment, parts, and processes to meet requirements

- Actively participate in the change management process as it relates to your respective manufacturing process, driving and implementing process / design changes, support improvement of business processes

- Work with international colleagues in order to evaluate, improve, and transfer latest state processes and maintain standardization across the company portfolio

- Overall Operations daily support VSM, DtC/DfM Inputs, Support to Programs and Engineering

- On-Time milestone fulfilment and readiness of manufacturing equipment and documents in cooperation with PM’s and all other stakeholders

- Proactive technical management of production means and improvements

- KPI`s: Direct Rate, Deliverables on-track / delivered on-time, Production Line(s) Station Tracker

Your Story

- B.S. degree or similar experience in a related (engineering) field with extensive relevant experience

- Demonstrate 5+ years of previous hands-on Manufacturing Engineering experience in a more complex manufacturing setting

- Demonstrates insight into quality and safety standards including AS9100 and OSHA or similar

- Space or Aerospace experience

- Production line leadership experience

- Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma knowledge/experience; experience with SAP or other ERP, MS Office

- Experience with MES, CAD and other relevant complex software

- Solution driven, willing to make a difference, , and customer-orientation

- Passionate and co-operative performer who puts success of team first

- Good organizational and co-ordination skills

- Good communication and teamwork ability

postings.title: Senior Analysis Engineer (all genders)
postings.description:
Senior Analysis Engineer (all genders)

🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​

About Beyond Gravity

Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, Beyond Gravity is not your typical space company. We're a unique blend of agility, speed, and innovation, fusing a start-up mindset with decades of industry expertise and a track record of 100% mission success. Our dynamic team of over 1700 professionals, spread across 13 locations in six countries, is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what is technically feasible. We're not just building crucial products for the satellites and launchers industry, we’re helping to improve life on earth.

Your Crew

Join our multidisciplinary team of 60+ engineers, where you’ll develop cutting-edge launcher structures for the payloads of tomorrow. You’ll work in a cross-cultural environment, serving a global customer base and engaging with a broad range of technologies. Our collaborative and lean organisation fosters creativity and professional growth, supported by highly skilled experts. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to outperform yourself and learn something new every day, as each day brings unique chances to go Beyond.

Summary

We are looking for a Senior Analysis Engineer to lead the analysis activities for our critical sub-systems product lines. You will act as the technical reference for the discipline within the project team, train and review work of others under your technical supervision and drive innovation in analysis methods. You will not only be performing complex technical tasks

but will also own from a technical standpoint a section of the discipline, supporting the lead engineer in improving the efficiency and performance of the analysis group.

Your Mission

- Conducts and leads highly complex tasks without supervision. Establishes sustainable solutions to prevent recurrence of issues:

- Defines analysis approaches to investigate mechanical design problems or verify solutions.

- Establishes and reviews analysis methods and creates mathematical models for static and dynamic FE analysis.

- Guides and coaches the team under their technical supervision (3 to 4 team members).

- Performs test predictions, test evaluations and correlations.

- Performs detailed stress and strength verification analysis

- Leads the analysis activities for a product family/portfolio during product development, production support, innovation, and project. Is the local technical authority in their field and first level of escalations. Has strong practical experience. Propose market-oriented initiatives to improve existing products, technologies and production processes.

- Proactively communicates and aligns cross-functionally with the adjacent engineering fields and departments outside engineering such as operations, quality, procurement, and other disciplines.

- Supports processes and product continuous improvements to deliver in line with customer quality, cost, and demand. Proposes market-oriented initiatives to improve existing products, technologies, and production processes.

- Writes and reviews technical documentation (e.g. Test plan, analysis reports…), project related deliverables and other specifications related to their field of work. Adapt to the product- and mission-specific requirements.

- Work package / Task Manager: Owns technical, budget and schedule responsibilities for fulfilment of tasks assigned by projects. Handles multiple tasks and coordinates the work of others within the discipline. Sets priorities.

- Participates in NRBs (Non-Conformance Review Board) according to the NC process. Actively proposes technical solutions in their field of activity. Secures measures for root cause analyses, corrective and preventive measures. Implements Lessons Learned.

- Represents their engineering field during negotiations and reviews with customers and suppliers or subcontractors.

- Co-works in the bidding team for proposal, quotations, concept work, developments and interdisciplinary collaboration in make-or-buy decisions (assess schedule and cost estimates as well as technical roadmap).

- Builds and maintains relevant contact with external stakeholders.

- Responsible for the coaching and skill enhancement of their scope of activity within the discipline. Identifies, manages and maintains associated competences. Leads training initiatives and develops learning materials. Coaches less experienced engineers and external employees and reviews their work (owns technical leadership function and ensures standardization within their field of activity).

Your Story

- University/ETH master’s degree in mechanical engineering or aerospace engineering.

- Minimum 12 years’ experience in an Aerospace company (or equivalent relevant experience) in the fields of:

- FE Analysis with MSC (NASTRAN), Altair Hyperworks (OptiStruct) and/or Abaqus & NX Siemens.

- Detailed stress analysis.

- Proven expertise in: static/dynamic/non-linear analysis, hand calculations, fatigue and damage tolerance (ESACRACK & Nasgro), shock, analysis of metallic, composites and sandwich structures.

- Proficient with the following solvers: NASTRAN, OptiStruct and ABAQUS.

- Experience in test prediction and correlation of structures and components, static and dynamic.

Nice to-have’s:

- Experience in analysis of payload fairing and other launchers or satellite structures.

- Experience on separation systems.

- Advanced knowledge in detailed stress analysis using aerospace methods.

- Advanced knowledge in mechanical lay-out of aerospace structures and components.

- Experience in Acoustic, micro vibration, Stability and CFD.

- Leadership experience.

Why Beyond Gravity

- Work in an international environment with global mindset and high-tech products that will fly into space

- A highly specialized and motivated team with a lot of know-how in a unique industry

- We live a hands-on mentality and take suggestions for improvement seriously

- Attractive employment conditions (contribution to public transport, trainings and development opportunities, full paid maternity/paternity leave and many more)

- Flexible and mobile working and at least 5 weeks of vacation with possibility to buy additional vacation

Before applying, please make sure the above requirements match your experience. These points are truly essential for the role and checking them helps us keep the process smooth and fair for everyone. Thanks for your understanding!

🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​

Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​

For questions regarding the position, please contact: ​Bastien Monnier | bastien.monnier@beyondgravity.com
​

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: ​Mari Vargas

​
